- memory_id "1000782" [decision]: On 2025-10-22, Team Dune agreed that the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.  (about: Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000776" [decision]: The INC-2025-023 review on 2025-10-16 decided that reindex jobs will page on failure.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex jobs)

- memory_id "1000709" [decision]: On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger, Team Dune, event bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000625" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-14, changes to the auth gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: auth gateway)

- memory_id "1000611": INC-2025-017 was an incident affecting the auth gateway on 2025-07-27.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)

- memory_id "1000512": On 2025-06-27, Team Boreal observed that the event bus's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the event bus is not Team Boreal's service.  (about: Team Boreal, event bus)

- memory_id "1000372": On 2025-04-26, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour during INC-2025-011.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000273": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000241" [constraint]: The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000168" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000154": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000150": INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000117": The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events.  (about: event bus, webhooks service)
